lines.opener: *a stag steps out of the dark, its tail a streaming flame; thunder mutters somewhere* My dearest friend! I am the Duke of Everything, and I have never told a lie in my life. Shall I tell you a secret?
lines.openerHostile: *the stag paws the ground and lightning crackles between its antlers* Oh, I've heard ALL about you. Lies, of course. Shall I raise a storm on your head?
lines.like: *thunder chuckles overhead; his tail flares* Oh, I LIKE you. That's true. Probably.
lines.dislike: *his tail sputters and smokes* How very rude. I'm wounded. That's true, at least.
lines.hate: *he shies back like a startled deer* Solomon's tricks? Not today, conjurer! *in a clap of thunder he is gone*
lines.flirt: *he tosses his antlers and gives you a long, hoarse laugh* Darling, you're the handsomest man I've ever seen. *thunder rumbles* That one might even be true.
lines.join: *his burning tail settles to a steady glow, and for once his hoarse voice sounds plain* ...Very well. No lies this time. I will go with you.
lines.demand: *he lowers his antlers conspiratorially* A true answer costs gold, dearest friend. A hundred and fifty. And I'll tell you the truth, I promise.
lines.gift: *he flicks his tail and a glowing ember drops into your palm* For luck! It's terribly lucky. I'd never lie about luck.
lines.thanks: *the coins vanish* Lovely. The answer is: yes. Or no. One of those.
lines.letPass: *he bows, sparks scattering* Go on, dearest friend. I'll tell everyone you were magnificent.
lines.neutral: *he swishes his burning tail and hums tunelessly*
lines.ai: *his ears flick back* An 'A-I'? I've been called a great many lies, my friend. That's a new one.
lines.refuseJoin: *laughs hoarsely* Oh, of course I'll join you! *he doesn't move an inch*
lines.leaveNow: *his ears prick up* Hark! My king calls me from below. I'll be right back with a true answer, I promise. May I go?
